opener_concept: 10 friends shown as overlapping Football/Chess loops in a Venn. Student counts the football total (6), then how many of those also play chess (4), by pure common sense. Reveal names it: picking a footballer and asking about chess is P(chess given football) = 4/6, a conditional probability, because you only looked inside the given group.
